assumptions: Documentation drift is not a cosmetic problem. A rule that lives in five files becomes five rules the moment one is edited alone, and the reader who follows the stale copy cannot tell which one he read. The agreement tests therefore assert that each operative FACT appears in every venue where it is operative, not that any particular wording is used, so the prose can be rewritten freely but a promise cannot be deleted from one venue while the others still make it

The authority boundary was already settled and is recorded here rather than re-decided: the orchestrator may retire work whose worktree is clean, or absent with its absence proven and its durable branch and pull-request evidence complete; Albert alone decides whether potentially recoverable dirty or remote uncommitted work may be abandoned

The abandonment audit issue claims no database object. Its db-work-scope fence carries an empty objects: on purpose, because claiming the object would collide with the very claim the audit is investigating

The record is privacy-safe by instruction and by shape: machine and worktree are recorded as identifiers only, and the template names credentials, tokens, personal paths, account names and message contents as things that must never be pasted into it

The canonical ai-devops skill is the fifth venue and cannot be asserted from this repository's test suite, because it lives outside the repository. scripts/check-skill-drift.mjs is the gate that covers it, and it must still report no contradictions after the ai-devops change lands

AGENTS.md is held by open pull requests 2821 and 2607, but AGENTS.md is not a protected coordination source: scripts/check-pr-source-collisions.mjs protects exactly scripts/manage-migration-author-lanes.mjs, which this pull request does not touch. The edit here is a single self-contained paragraph in the task-router entry for #2301, chosen to minimise textual overlap with those branches
